# On The Mark Heating N Air, LLC

> Heating & air conditioning based in Liberty Hill, Texas. On The Mark Heating N Air repairs, replaces and maintains heating and air around Liberty Hill and Bertram. Reviewers say Mark answers, shows up fast, any hour, and explains exactly what's wrong.

## Services
- AC repair & diagnostics: Diagnosis done right, including second opinions and evidence for a warranty claim.
- Heating repair: Heater and furnace repair with Mark staying until the system is running properly.
- New systems & replacement: System sales, replacements and new installs for homes and businesses.
- Ductless mini-splits: Mini-split installs for rooms, shops and spaces without ductwork.
- Maintenance & inspections: Tune-ups, filters and inspections, plus tips to keep the system efficient.
- Thermostats & leak detection: Smart Wi-Fi thermostat installs and refrigerant leak finding.

## About
On The Mark Heating N Air, LLC is owned by Mark Partain and based in the Liberty Hill and Bertram area northwest of Austin. Mark answers the calls himself, and lead tech Jake works alongside him. The company is a licensed Texas ACR contractor (TACLA94179). Mark has been in the trade for more than a decade, and some customers have used him since his first jobs. The business is listed as open 24 hours, and reviewers describe night and weekend calls, honest second opinions, and even a 10 PM drive to Port O'Connor.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you give a second opinion on my AC?
  A: Yes. One Liberty Hill-area customer took Mark's diagnosis back to a warranty company, and the whole unit was replaced two days later.
- Q: Do you take night and weekend calls?
  A: Yes. The business is listed as open 24 hours, and reviewers describe Mark and Jake coming out at night.
- Q: How fast can you get to Bertram or Liberty Hill?
  A: Often within the hour. One customer had Mark at the door 45 minutes after calling.
- Q: Do you install smart thermostats?
  A: Yes. Mark installs smart Wi-Fi thermostats and has brought a new one along on a service call.
- Q: Are you licensed?
  A: Yes. On The Mark is a licensed Texas ACR contractor, TACLA94179.
